overloadMerges.note: queryOp's comma-separated symbol alternatives (Text, >, <, >=, <=, #, =, |, %) were mechanically split into one single-symbol TypeRef per token; consolidated into one literal_symbols TypeRef (plus the Text alternative for the alphanumeric-operator form) with documented meanings.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table for which to return a selection of records, or the default table if omitted

params.name: conjOp
params.description: Conjunction operator used to join this call to a preceding call in the same multi-query sequence; omitted on the first/only call

params.name: objectField
params.description: Object field whose attribute is queried

params.name: attributePath
params.description: Name or dot path of the object attribute to query

params.name: queryOp
params.description: Comparison operator between the attribute and value; can also be passed as an alphanumeric Text expression instead of a symbol (e.g. from a variable) to build configurable queries

params.name: value
params.description: Value the attribute is compared against
If passed, more calls follow in this multi-query sequence; omitted on the final call, which executes the accumulated query

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Queries an object/entity attribute (objectField.attributePath) of the records currently selected in aTable, restricting the current selection to those matching the comparison, and can be chained across multiple calls joined by conjOp/'*'.

constraints: Scope differs from QUERY BY ATTRIBUTE: QUERY SELECTION BY ATTRIBUTE only searches within aTable's current selection, whereas QUERY BY ATTRIBUTE searches every record in the table; otherwise both commands work the same way.
Most useful when a query needs to run against a current selection that did not itself come from a previous QUERY BY ATTRIBUTE/QUERY call (e.g. one produced by USE SET).
